program_code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform row or column is the divider between two equal panels.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and h % 2 == 1:
            half = h // 2
            if r == half:
                a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
                color = set(sum(a, [])).intersection(sum(b, []))

            half = w // 2

                a = [row[:x] for row in grid]
                b = [row[x + 1:] for row in grid]
                color = set(sum(a, [])).intersection(sum(b, []))
                if len(color) == 1:
                    c = next(iter(color))
                    return [[3 if a[y][j] == c and b[y][j] == c else c
